name: @openhoo/hooversion
description: Conventional commit linting and semantic release automation for multi-ecosystem repositories.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js && bun build src/app.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=dist/app.js && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/app.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
